mission.primary: Measure divergence, quantify constrained value, model lawful recovery pathways, and verify deployment integrity using deterministic and auditable analysis.
mission.secondary: Provide a citizen-first system that converts complex structural, economic, legal, and funding data into understandable and inspectable outputs.
mission.human_readable: A.B.E. helps users understand what drifted, what it cost, what can be recovered, where recovery can go, and whether deployment remains stable.

core_principles.local_execution: All primary analysis runs locally in-browser whenever possible.
core_principles.deterministic_outputs: Given the same inputs and model assumptions, outputs should remain reproducible.
core_principles.plain_language: Users should not need to be lawyers, economists, auditors, or engineers to understand the system.
core_principles.auditability: Every major module should produce structured artifacts that can be inspected and verified.
core_principles.transparency: Models, formulas, assumptions, and outputs should remain inspectable.
core_principles.human_first: The engine evaluates systems, structures, incentives, deployment pathways, and institutions — not the worth of individual people.
core_principles.privacy: User-controlled artifacts, no hidden uploads, no silent third-party transmission.

INTAKE.name: Document Intake + OCR Bridge
INTAKE.purpose: Normalize uploaded documents, OCR text, pasted content, and structured user inputs into local artifacts.

CAE.name: Constitutional Alignment Engine
CAE.purpose: Establish baseline alignment conditions and governing framework references.

CDA.name: Constitutional Divergence Analyzer
CDA.purpose: Identify divergence flags, scope conditions, structural conflicts, and system-level deviations.

CDI.name: Constitutional Divergence Index
CDI.purpose: Measure divergence severity using weighted deterministic scoring models.

CIRI.name: Constitutional Integrity ROI Engine
CIRI.purpose: Quantify recoverable capital, constrained participation, and modeled economic recovery.

CIBS.name: Constitutional Integrity Baseline Schema
CIBS.purpose: Allocate modeled recovery capital into structured deployment categories.

CII.name: Constitutional Integrity Index
CII.purpose: Measure propagation, effectiveness, and modeled downstream impact.

INTEGRATION.name: Audit & SHA-256 Integrity Layer
INTEGRATION.purpose: Verify artifacts, generate receipts, and preserve deterministic auditability.

MACRO.name: Macroeconomic Cascade Model
MACRO.purpose: Project broader economic activation and propagation effects across sectors and jurisdictions.

RT.name: Rebuild Together Engine
RT.purpose: Map recoverable capital into deployment sectors, activation systems, and reinvestment pathways.

CFF.name: Constitutional Funding Forensics
CFF.purpose: Evaluate funding alignment, scope conditions, and structured allocation integrity.

CCRI.name: Consumer Credit Risk Integrity
CCRI.purpose: Measure participation constraints, credit-access friction, and consumer-side structural exposure.

AFFE.name: Appropriation Fidelity & Funding Engine
AFFE.purpose: Normalize funding documents, evaluate appropriation fidelity, support funding-alignment review, and measure post-deployment stability.

citizen_flow.goal: Users should be able to upload once, run the pipeline, read plain-language findings, and export audit-ready artifacts.

final_principle: A.B.E. exists to transform complex structural systems into understandable, inspectable, deterministic, and auditable recovery analysis.
